椭圆$\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$的参数方程为$$\begin{cases}x=2a\cos\theta\\y=b\sin\theta\end{cases}\quad\theta从0变到2\pi$$
原式$$\int_0^{2\pi}[(2a\cos\theta+b\sin\theta)(-2a\sin\theta)+(2a\cos\theta-b\sin\theta)b\cos\theta]d\theta$$
